formal_object.rationale: Centered paired training covariance with ridge defines two-sided regularized canonical correlations.

operations_and_conditions.rationale: A05: Whiten both sides with A_q,A_c. Condition: rho>0 ensures invertibility D01: Top singular pairs of A_q S A_c solve the correlation problem. Condition: Whitened coordinates u,v

derivation.rationale: Whiten each covariance and apply SVD to the cross covariance; map the left/right singular directions back to their sides.

assumptions.rationale: Only released fitting positive pairs determine means/covariances. Centering and ridge are frozen at evaluation; no test fitting. Regularized correlation maximization is not a semantic relevance guarantee. These are conditional premises, not observed benchmark facts.

method_expression.rationale: Train-only centered two-view maps are explicit. Pair quality/domain shift remain assumptions, not empirical discoveries.

prediction_and_falsifier.rationale: Only training cross-correlated directions are emphasized; uncorrelated but useful complementary semantics can be discarded. Falsification: Whitening or Procrustes with the same information/rank reaches the same native outcome, or domain-shifted correlations harm retrieval.

closest_alternative.rationale: CCA is known; same-dimensional Procrustes and independent whitening isolate whether cross covariance matters. This check only reviews the stated mathematical comparison; exhaustive full-text/author-code/native collision and originality decisions remain pending.

review_independence: Single-agent self-review; not a blinded/independent novelty or empirical review.
claim_scope: Conditional formal construction only. No code/test/design/result/native-parent qualification.
